entries.title: Activity shows one line for a run of changes to one setting
entries.body: Dragging the window wash slider, pressing a size key a few times or folding a panel and opening it again used to write a line for every step. Now a run of your own changes to one setting is one line, such as "window wash 48% → 76%", and a run that ends where it started leaves no line. A change Firstmate makes for you is still a line of its own.

picture.alt: Activity with a crewmate's lines and, under them, one line for a whole drag of the window wash: Captain · window wash 0% → 76%
